ns2:section.sectionText: Intro to Psych. In this Discovery section the same general psychology course content (see http://www.psych.uiuc.edu/~gossluca/info_course.php for a description), but with more of an active learning approach. Students work in small groups on one semester long project. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
ns2:section.sectionCappArea: Restricted to First Time Freshman students.
